verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent. A product of this kind could plausibly expose a programmatic API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only UI-driven features (model picker, Settings Library, composer toggle, update menu) and a launch flag for the password store. Nothing shows a public API, let alone one with parity to the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
